analyst.summary: Pine Labs continues to grow its payments and commerce platform at a healthy pace, processing a very large volume of transactions, and its reported profit jumped sharply in the latest quarter. However, a closer look at its core operating profitability (excluding one-off items) shows margins actually narrowed slightly over the past year, suggesting the reported profit improvement reflects lower one-off costs post-listing rather than the underlying business becoming more profitable. Combined with a valuation that already prices in a great deal of future growth, we would not hold this stock at current levels.
